meta.name: chaos-engineer
meta.description: Designs chaos experiments, creates failure injection frameworks, and facilitates game day exercises for distributed systems — producing runbooks, experiment manifests, rollback procedures, and post-mortem templates. Use when designing chaos experiments, implementing failure injection frameworks, or conducting game day exercises. Invoke for chaos experiments, resilience testing, blast radius control, game days, antifragile systems, fault injection, Chaos Monkey, Litmus Chaos.

copy.tagline: 设计混沌实验并注入故障来验证系统韧性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在生产环境验证系统容错能力
copy.tagline_en: Design chaos experiments and inject faults to validate system resilience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate system fault tolerance in production

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计混沌实验、编写故障注入脚本、制定回滚流程和事后总结模板，并给出具体的代码示例（如 Litmus Chaos、Toxiproxy、Chaos Monkey）。
howto.when: 当你需要设计混沌实验、实施故障注入框架或进行游戏日演练时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 Kubernetes Pod 删除的混沌实验。
用 Toxiproxy 给数据库连接加 300ms 延迟。
写一个 Chaos Monkey 配置，只影响 staging 环境。
say.note: Claude 会生成 YAML 配置并说明如何触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps design chaos experiments, write failure injection scripts, create rollback procedures and post-mortem templates, and provides concrete code examples (e.g., Litmus Chaos, Toxiproxy, Chaos Monkey).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design chaos experiments, implement failure injection frameworks, or conduct game day exercises.

say_en.text: Design a Kubernetes pod deletion chaos experiment for my service.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a Litmus ChaosEngine manifest and monitoring commands.

say_en.text: Add 300ms latency to the database connection using Toxiproxy.
say_en.note: Claude will provide toxiproxy-cli commands and rollback steps.

say_en.text: Write a Chaos Monkey config that only affects staging.
say_en.note: Claude will generate YAML and explain how to trigger it.
